scope: Current source dispatch for canonical equipped move IDs1..467. Source inspection only; no build/test/emulator. Actual in-battle frame placement still depends on combat state, actor pose, direction and camera.
source_evidence: src/arena/combat_native_rules.inc:sNativeRules plus combat.c:ApplyStatus for event trigger examples
priority_findings: 15 sustained beam move IDs; only4 source strip styles.
Flamethrower, FireBlast, SacredFire share MEDIUM/THIN; HydroPump uses WATER; IceBeam/AuroraBeam use ICE.
Nine other beam identities use WATER pixels recolored to two neutral gray/white colors.
WaterGun/WaterPulse/Surf/BubbleBeam share WATER atlas8..11; they do not use HydroPump beam art.
Any projectile with ARENA_VIS_STAR uses Swift sprite before type dispatch.
Old arena_extra_tiles/arena_extra_palette are compiled historical assets but the current renderer loads arena_v096_tiles/arena_v096_palette instead.
Manifest compatible_moves and canonical_move_candidates are not runtime dispatch.

lab_blastoise.note: PracticeTeam obtains native primary type; Blastoise type11 selects WaterPulse in beamByType despite that array name. Slot1 HydroPump; slot2 Tackle; slot3 Swift. Clash mode foes instead get HydroPump in slot0.

BEAM_FIRE_THIN_MEDIUM.selection: THIN while not clashing and (age < 6 or remaining < 6); MEDIUM otherwise. age = clamp(actionTick-profile.windup,0,255). remaining = clamp(profile.windup+profile.active-actionTick,0,255).
BEAM_FIRE_THIN_MEDIUM.palette_modification: None to nontransparent source colors; global spare colors14/15 are set gray/white.

BEAM_NEUTRAL_WATER.pixel_modification: For each nonzero palette index: 1..3 -> 14; 4..15 -> 15. Preserve index0 transparency.
BEAM_NEUTRAL_WATER.note: All nine neutral sustained beam identities share the WATER silhouette; named source-family candidates do not override this branch.

SWIFT_STAR.dispatch_precedence: Any projectile whose profile.visual == ARENA_VIS_STAR, before native-type family selection.

PRIMITIVE_ORB.selection: Native type chooses ElementOrb(); normally includes up to two same-orb trails when projectile.radius >= 5.
PRIMITIVE_ORB.note: These are code-drawn circles, not imported sprites. STAR precedence handles many special attacks before this fallback.

DASH_WIND.note: Dash input effect, not assigned by move identity.

MOTION_MELEE.note: No independent launch sprite from this kind. Followthrough, held shield, stage changes, generic startup rings and contacts can add effects.

MOTION_RUSH.note: No independent launch sprite from this kind. Followthrough, held shield, stage changes, generic startup rings and contacts can add effects.

MOTION_SELF.note: No independent launch sprite from this kind. Followthrough, held shield, stage changes, generic startup rings and contacts can add effects.

ATLAS_HIT.event_usage: COMBAT_CONTACT; COMBAT_BLOCK; default combat effects including COMBAT_RING; generic damage/contact and startup puffs. Contact: age<8 and tick=age*3. Default branch: age<8 and tick=age*3. Also generic non-beam cones by native type.

ATLAS_ELECTRIC.status_usage: Paralysis: frame%72<12, tick=(frame%72)*2. No current projectile draws ELECTRIC, because electric projectile profiles are STAR and return before type dispatch.

ATLAS_SHADOW.status_usage: Any active status other than burn/paralysis/freeze, during frame%72<12. Includes poison/sleep where present.

ATLAS_GUARD.event_usage: Held guard/guardTimer, including Protect when it activates guard. Startup uses frames42 and43; held uses44. Renderer copies/pads to a64x64 live cell and scales to actor body bounds. Other manifest guard frames are not used by HeldShield().
ATLAS_GUARD.conditional_trigger_note: Protect/Detect native special6 opens guard. Direct held guard input also uses this art.

ATLAS_CLASH.event_usage: Beam clash pressure/resolution (scaled) and unpaired COMBAT_CLASH events; no specific launch move owns this sprite.

ATLAS_BUFF.event_usage: Any observed stat-stage increase;24tick effect. No dedicated launch move dispatch.
ATLAS_BUFF.conditional_trigger_note: Direct native stage-effect candidates from combat_native_rules.inc. Effect requires application/success and an observed stage difference; chance and stage caps can suppress it. Haze resets and Psych Up copying can additionally raise or lower observed stages depending on combat state.

ATLAS_DEBUFF.event_usage: Any observed stat-stage decrease;24tick effect. No dedicated launch move dispatch.
ATLAS_DEBUFF.conditional_trigger_note: Direct native stage-effect candidates from combat_native_rules.inc. Effect requires application/success and an observed stage difference; chance and stage caps can suppress it. Haze resets and Psych Up copying can additionally raise or lower observed stages depending on combat state.

shared_runtime_rules.atlas_cone_tick: fighter.actionTick + step/6 for step14..profile.range in24px intervals
shared_runtime_rules.followthrough_dispatch: Any active profile.visual CLAW -> SLASH or LEAF -> LEAF, independently of primary kind; includes projectile/cone/self profiles.
shared_runtime_rules.beam_geometry: Four32x32 chunks form128x32 strip; affine transformed to actor source point/end reach; grow over6 ticks; clash endpoint shared.
shared_runtime_rules.beam_runtime_palette: arena_beam_palette copied every draw, slot14=0x6318, slot15=0x7fff.
shared_runtime_rules.old_extra_assets: arena_extra_tiles and arena_extra_palette are not loaded by current renderer. ArenaExtra_ForType is still used for family IDs only.
